gate._note: Verdict (request-changes vs approve vs unavailable) lives in the PR review comment, not the run conclusion; classification wiring is deferred to the recalibration pass once real gate comments exist to pattern-match. Baseline reports run counts only.

credit_burn._note: Cursor's credit pool is not GitHub-queryable; operator-supplied (brief §7 [U]).

fix_success._scope_note: fix_prs_* = new-branch fixes (ci-autofix/, issue-autofix/) only; in-place P3a fixes (Autofix-Attempt trailer on the PR branch) are uncounted pending trailer-scan wiring.

time_to_green._note: Proxy = mergedAt − createdAt of merged fix PRs; refine to first-failing-run → merge in the recalibration pass.

override_rate._note: Requires correlating gate request-changes verdicts with human merges; deferred with gate-verdict classification.

cost_per_fix._note: credit_burn / fix_prs_merged; null until credit burn is operator-supplied.
